# EolianVR

> EolianVR, Inc. develops Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), Mixed Reality (MR), AI/ML, and 3D animation solutions for defense, government, and enterprise clients. Founded in 2017, the company is best known for ARTAK, an immersive command-and-control (C2) platform for multi-domain joint operations, 3D mission planning, and real-time situational awareness.

## Core Products

- [ARTAK](https://www.eolianvr.com/artak): An AR/VR command-and-control platform that fuses drone feeds, sensor data, and geospatial overlays into a shared 3D operational picture for defense, public safety, and enterprise missions. Supports Multi-Domain Operations (MDO) and Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2).
- [MapMaker](https://www.eolianvr.com/mapmaker): A 3D terrain and geospatial data processing tool that converts LiDAR, UAV, and photogrammetry data into mission-ready 3D environments for mission planning and rehearsal.

## Use Cases

ARTAK is deployed across: disaster response and emergency management, search & rescue, security and protection services, police and law enforcement, fire and emergency services, and space and aerospace operations. See [Use Cases](https://www.eolianvr.com/artak/national-security) for details.
